messages.content: Find me all the classical concerts near Berlin and Paris happening next Friday, and I am interested only in those with available parking.

function.name: concert_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby concerts based on specific criteria like genre and availability of parking. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where the user wants to find a concert.

So 2026-07-01 would be Thursday + 181 days? 2026-07-01 is 181 days after Jan 1? Actually from Jan 1 to July 1 is 181 days (31+28+31+30+31+30=181). 181 mod 7 = 6. So Thursday + 6 days = Wednesday? Wait, Thursday + 6 days = Wednesday? Let's compute: Thursday + 1 = Friday, +2 = Saturday, +3 = Sunday, +4 = Monday, +5 = Tuesday, +6 = Wednesday. So 2026-07-01 is Wednesday. Then 2026-07-08 is Wednesday + 7 days = Wednesday. So 2026-07-08 is Wednesday. Next Friday after Wednesday is Friday of same week: 2026-07-10. So date is 2026-07-10.
